column1: # so the Android, Dart and Windows ATT mappings are held to one table instead of
# drifting apart. Apple's `attErrorToUniversalBleErrorCode` maps the same way but
# its XCTest (example/ios/RunnerTests) still asserts a hand-written list; it can
# be pointed at this fixture too.
#     att_code       ATT error code in hex, as the platform delivers it
#     expected       the UniversalBleErrorCode raw value the code maps to
# Codes 0x80-0xFF are application-defined: they are not protocol errors, so the
# mappings driven by this fixture (Dart, Android, Windows) report them as
# unknownError. Linux is not driven by this fixture: its wrapper falls back to the
# caller's default code (readFailed / writeFailed / ...) whenever the ATT code
